budgets._comment: Re-baselined when the shell replaced its overflow menu with one named nav. Every destination is now in the prerendered HTML, which is what makes them crawlable and reachable without JavaScript, so ~15 labelled rows and their icons ship in the shell instead of 6. Raised again when theme and accent joined the navigation: the sidebar's copy of the pair ships in the shell, which is ~2 KiB of icon markup raw and nothing measurable brotli. The Menu sheet's copy waits for the sheet, so it costs the shell nothing. Header settings and project links add about 1.7 KiB of raw shell markup. The complete home-page bundle flow adds about 1.4 KiB of raw semantic markup while reducing the Brotli size below this budget's compressed target. The Extract workflow adds one labelled Files row to the shell. The guided cheat tours add about 0.2 KiB of raw home-shell markup; the approved raw limit is 56,000 bytes. The file-type home page puts its file router, one-pass steps, format lists, privacy notes and FAQ in the prerendered shell so search engines can read them, bringing it to 57,082 raw and 11,378 Brotli bytes; the approved limits are 58,000 and 11,600 bytes. Buffering files picked or dropped before hydration adds an inline script of about 0.9 KiB raw and 0.3 KiB Brotli: main measured 56.4 KiB raw and 11.2 KiB Brotli in CI, and the change measured 57.3 KiB and 11.5 KiB, so the limits rise from 58,000 and 11,600 to 59,500 and 12,100 bytes.

budgets._comment: Raised for the Extract workflow route and its browser archive selection UI. Raised again for the browser feature map and the Identify, Extract, Convert, Trim, PPF Undo, and Settings guides, whose rendered pages ship as docs route chunks. Raised again for the ISO to RVZ, Nintendo 3DS to Z3DS, and Extract Z3DS guides, whose route chunks add about 11 KiB raw and 3 KiB Brotli. Raised again for the Pro Action Rocky, Gold Finger, and GBA GameShark/Action Replay code types and the create form's code type picker. Raised for the WebMCP tools and eleven browser workflow adapters. Raised for the published native benchmarks and expanded format guides. The CI bundle measures 2,496,524 raw bytes and 639,096 Brotli bytes; the approved limits retain 70,000 raw and 9,000 Brotli bytes above the baseline. Raised again for guided Apply's add-files step and the Guided practice runs reference page: main measured 632.7 KiB Brotli, 1.1 KiB under the old 649,000-byte limit, and the change adds 3.2 KiB (the new page's route chunk is 1.5 KiB of it, the rest is the guide, its de/es copy, and the linking doc edits), bringing the bundle to 635.9 KiB. The Brotli limit rises by 5,000 bytes to keep about 2.8 KiB of headroom; the raw limit is unchanged. Raised by 2,000 Brotli bytes for PPF Undo archive ingestion, candidate selection, disc companions, and output compression after shared-helper reuse and route simplification. The measured production bundle was 2,559,908 raw and 655,107 Brotli bytes; no source modules were duplicated across chunks. The raw ceiling is unchanged. Approved 512-byte increase for browser recovery fixes after deduplication: the baseline measured 655,975 Brotli bytes, and the committed candidate measured 656,483 bytes. No chunks were added or duplicated. The approved ceiling includes another 1,024 bytes for generated-hash compression variance: bundles with the same 2,470,171 raw bytes measured 656,161 to 656,714 Brotli bytes across committed builds. The de and es locale catalogs are lazy chunks that no first-paint path loads, so they moved to their own budget; every JavaScript limit here dropped by exactly their measured size (82,648 raw and 23,260 Brotli bytes), leaving the same headroom as before. Raised by 2,048 Brotli bytes (user approved) for the translated cheat database, Save Editor and emulator saves, which add about 1.2 KiB of English catalog and component code to the main chunk; the measured bundle is 2,400,972 raw and 635,534 Brotli bytes, and the raw limits are unchanged. Raised by 1,024 Brotli bytes (user approved) for checksumming and identifying every file added at once; the raw ceiling is unchanged. Expected sizes reset to the reviewed final aggregate, including dense patch verdict ordering: 2,362,391 raw and 635,991 Brotli bytes. Maximum ceilings are unchanged. Raised by 3,652 Brotli bytes (user approved) for routing dropped files to the workflow that fits: the shared routing rules and English strings, the shell wiring, and the lazy page-and-files dialog chunk add about 2.3 KiB Brotli; CI measured 2,370,765 raw and about 638,700 Brotli bytes, so the 641,000-byte limit keeps about 2.3 KiB of headroom. The raw ceiling is unchanged. Raised by 1,024 Brotli bytes (user approved) for search-targeted docs titles, intros, and tool links across eleven guide route chunks: main measured about 640,600 Brotli bytes locally, the change adds about 400 to 500, and CI measured about 641,100 (626.1 KiB). The 642,024-byte limit keeps about 0.9 KiB of headroom; the raw ceiling is unchanged. Raised by 2,000 Brotli bytes for the guide tool shortcuts below 24 guide titles and their translated labels: main measured 641,741 Brotli bytes in CI, 283 bytes under the 642,024-byte limit, and the change adds about 810, bringing CI to about 642,550. The 644,024-byte limit keeps about 1.4 KiB of headroom; the raw ceiling is unchanged. The combined selection handling and current guide content measure 2,414,586 raw and 644,439 Brotli bytes in CI; the compressed limit is 645,024 bytes, with the raw limit unchanged.

budgets._comment: The de and es message catalogs ship as separate lazy chunks (catalog.ts CATALOG_LOADERS), fetched only when the visitor's locale resolves to one of them, so they count against their own budget instead of the main JavaScript budget. The measured build is 82,648 raw and 23,260 Brotli bytes (de 41,163 and 11,955, es 41,485 and 11,305), and the main JavaScript limits dropped by exactly those amounts. The maximums leave about 14 KiB of Brotli (about 50 KiB raw at the catalogs' 3.55:1 ratio) for the planned translation batches: roughly 8 KiB for the settings, cheat and save-tool strings and roughly 6 KiB for the forms.
